summary: Backend testing of the new POST /api/chats/{chat_id}/invite-member endpoint and free-plan credits bump (100→300) is fully green: 5/5 pytest passed (permission gating 403 for non-admin, brand-new email creates workspace MEMBER with one_time_password + created_new_account=true, existing user by user_id added as member, duplicate returns 400 'User is already in this chat', OTP can log in, /api/billing/plans free plan shows monthly_credits=300, invite-guest regression still returns role=guest with OTP). Web UI is only partially verified: the open-add-member-btn (in Group Info Members tab) and invite-guest-btn are both present in the DOM as expected, and the AddMemberDialog.jsx component ships with every advertised data-testid. However, actually opening the AddMemberDialog in the Marketing Site Refresh chat is BLOCKED by a pre-existing 'You're almost out of credits' upsell modal that pops on chat load for Free-plan workspaces and persistently re-opens itself even after being closed (Escape / X-button / DOM node removal all fail after 3 attempts). This modal is triggered by having <=300 credits — i.e. the free plan cap now equals the low-credit threshold, so every free-plan chat entry now shows the nag on load, and it steals click focus from the Group Info side panel.

ui_bugs.issue: Modal auto-opens on every chat load for Free-plan workspaces and re-opens after being dismissed via Escape / X-button. Because it renders as a top-layer overlay it prevents users from interacting with the Group Info side panel — specifically the new 'Add' member button (data-testid=open-add-member-btn) and any AddMemberDialog opened underneath is not reachable. Threshold appears to fire when workspace credits == 300, which is now the Free-plan monthly grant, so 100% of Free workspaces will hit it on chat entry.

integration_issues.issue: AddMemberDialog opens correctly from open-add-member-btn wiring in code, but end-user cannot see/use it in Free-plan workspaces because the low-credits nag stacks on top and refuses to stay closed. Recommend either raising the nag threshold above 300 (e.g. <200) or suppressing it while a) another dialog is open, b) the same session already dismissed it once.

action_items: Fix the aggressive 'You're almost out of credits' nag: it fires at credits <= 300 which equals the new Free-plan grant, so it now blocks the very Add-member flow this iteration added. Either raise the trigger (e.g. <150) or auto-hide when any other dialog is open / after one dismissal per session.

Manually re-verify the AddMemberDialog end-to-end (invite by new email → credentials card with add-member-credentials showing add-member-copy-creds + add-member-done, quick-add ws member row, search-by-email/phone results) once the credit-modal blocker is resolved.
Consider auto-selecting the 'Members' tab on open — already the default via useState('members'), OK.
critical_code_review_comments: AddMemberDialog.jsx duplicates a lot of logic already in InviteGuestDialog (link card, search, brand-new-email form). Extracting a shared <ChatInvitePanel> that only differs in POST endpoint + role label would remove ~200 lines and future drift.
AddMemberDialog uses `confirm(...)` (native browser confirm) inside rotateLink — inconsistent with the rest of the app that uses shadcn AlertDialog / toasts.

In invite_member_to_chat backend endpoint: no explicit workspace_id scoping on the chat query (only member_ids). If a chat_id from another workspace happens to include current user_id it would still resolve — worth adding {'workspace_id': current['workspace_id']} guard for symmetry with invite-guest sibling.

success_rate.frontend: 50% (wiring verified, live dialog interaction blocked by unrelated credit-nag modal)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully verified via /app/backend/tests/test_iteration90_invite_member.py — 5 tests, all pass. The remaining unknown is the live UI flow of AddMemberDialog. To reproduce the blocker: log in as amit@demo.team, navigate to /chats/322e5d35-4c77-437e-a997-47e67d9871ae (Marketing Site Refresh), and observe the persistent 'You're almost out of credits' modal that immediately blocks all group-info-panel interactions. Once main agent fixes the nag threshold/behavior, re-run a Playwright script that: (1) opens Group Info (button[aria-label*='info']), (2) clicks [data-testid=open-add-member-btn], (3) submits a fresh email via [data-testid=add-member-new-email] + [data-testid=add-member-submit-new], (4) asserts [data-testid=add-member-credentials] appears with email + one-time password. All testIDs are already present in /app/frontend/src/components/AddMemberDialog.jsx (verified by code review).
rca of the issue: Free-plan monthly credits were increased from 100 → 300 in /app/backend/services/billing.py. The low-credit warning modal appears to compare current balance against a fixed threshold of ~300 (evidenced by the modal reading 'Only 300 credits left'), so a brand-new Free workspace at 300/300 now trips the warning on every chat entry. The regression is not in the new invite-member code — it is a side-effect of the credits bump colliding with the existing nag threshold. Mitigation: main agent should lower the nag trigger (e.g. balance < 20% of monthly grant, or a hard <150 for Free) or dismiss-once-per-session, and re-verify the AddMemberDialog flow end-to-end.
